decision_basis: On all 48 validation tasks, graded GRPO improved greedy success from 40 to 44 but raised adjacent repetition from 0.10635 to 0.72123. No ID test evaluation had started.
test_gate: The original coordinator was paused before the ID test. Freeze the diversity policy before resuming any test evaluation; evaluate all three policies once, including regressions.
control: Same original SFT adapter, seed, 128 groups, group size 4, learning rate 5e-5, beta 0.02, LoRA and task split as extended-study. Change only reward variant.
priority: Every fully compliant score gets at least 0.9; every noncompliant valid score gets at most 0.5625. Within compliant outputs, prefer fewer repeats and at least three distinct pitches.
selection: Final checkpoint only. No subsequent learning-rate, seed or checkpoint sweep in this ablation.
limits: This proxy can reward alternating templates and does not measure musical quality.
More groups may update because the new reward differentiates otherwise equal full-success samples.
One training seed; conclusions conditional on these runs.
validation: 48 same tasks; greedy and 4 stochastic samples per task. Compare SFT, graded GRPO and diversity-aware GRPO.
test: Once all policies are fixed, evaluate the same 48 previously untouched ID tasks for all three policies, greedy and 4 stochastic samples. OOD tests stay reserved.
evaluation_reward: Use graded reward for best-of-four selection for all policies, to keep the evaluation selector identical. Primary metrics use all candidates before selection.
